type10b.name: Type 10B
type10b.authority: Release 267 (owner 2026-10-31; Main 2026-10-31: the later production variant, one base, true size): the production Type 10 as the JGSDF photographs show it (profiles/type10X.ts: the bolted side blocks, the oval smoke slot, the four laser warners, the meshed basket, the ring M2's seat) carrying the Type 10 upgrade programme's fit: the ATLA call for companies of June 2024 and GSDF notice 1230 (28 October 2024) on active protection, with a remote weapon station (Janes) on the commander's ring, and the reactive armour the sides and roof are reported to take (Japanese Wikipedia). The fit is tendered, not fielded: the 10B is notional (vehicleFacets.ts concept), its armour the Type 10's own with the 10B's reactive seeds.
type10b.envelopeBasis: The as-built envelope (Box3 at both qualities) of the modern Type 10 it draws with its fit: 9.42 m gun forward (published 9.42 m), 3.49-3.50 m over the owner's field net on the skirts' reactive armour (the Type 10's 3.389 m source width, published 3.24 m: docs/references/tanks/type10_x.md), 4.122 m to the whips' tips.
